category_mapping.defense: Ministry of Defence demands taken whole: Defence Services (Revenue), Capital Outlay on Defence Services, Defence Pensions, and Ministry of Defence (Civil) [named 'Ministry of Defence (Misc.)' in FY2015-16/FY2016-17 documents].
category_mapping.health: Department of Health and Family Welfare; Department of Health Research; Ministry of Ayush (AYUSH - traditional medicine systems; judgment call, documented here).
category_mapping.education: Department of School Education and Literacy; Department of Higher Education.
category_mapping.social_protection: Department of Rural Development (incl. MGNREGA, PMAY-Gramin); Department of Land Resources (watershed/livelihood programmes under Rural Development - judgment call); Department of Social Justice and Empowerment; Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities; Department of Food and Public Distribution (food subsidy); Ministry of Tribal Affairs; Ministry of Minority Affairs; Ministry of Women and Child Development; Ministry of Labour and Employment.
category_mapping.economic_affairs: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare (earlier '...Cooperation and Farmers Welfare'); Department of Agricultural Research and Education; Department of Fisheries; Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying [FY2015-16/FY2016-17: combined 'Department of Animal Husbandry, Dairying and Fisheries']; Ministry of Food Processing Industries; Department of Fertilisers (fertiliser subsidy - JUDGMENT CALL: treated as agricultural input subsidy per COFOG agriculture, not social protection); Ministries of Railways; Road Transport and Highways; Jal Shakti departments - Water Resources, River Development and Ganga Rejuvenation, and Drinking Water and Sanitation (JUDGMENT: water-supply infrastructure); Power; New and Renewable Energy; Petroleum and Natural Gas; Coal; Mines; Steel; Textiles; Department of Commerce; Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade [earlier 'Department of Industrial Policy and Promotion']; Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises; Electronics and Information Technology (Digital India); Telecommunications; Posts (JUDGMENT: communications infrastructure); Civil Aviation; Ports, Shipping and Waterways [earlier 'Ministry of Shipping']; Science and Technology; Biotechnology; Scientific and Industrial Research; Atomic Energy; Space; Heavy Industries; Chemicals and Petrochemicals; Pharmaceuticals; Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (JUDGMENT: vocational training for employment); Development of North Eastern Region (JUDGMENT: regional development); Earth Sciences (JUDGMENT: scientific services); Ministry of Cooperation (JUDGMENT: cooperatives).
category_mapping.general_admin: Finance Ministry establishment taken whole EXCLUDING Interest Payments (separate demand): Departments of Economic Affairs, Expenditure, Financial Services, Public Enterprises, Investment and Public Asset Management (DIPAM), Revenue; Direct Taxes; Indirect Taxes; Indian Audit and Accounts Department (note: includes some scheme/capital-infusion spending, e.g. bank recapitalisation under Financial Services, not separable at demand level); 'Pensions' demand (civil pensions administered by Department of Expenditure - JUDGMENT; Defence Pensions stays in defense); 'Transfers to States' (Finance Commission/general intergovernmental transfers, COFOG 01.8 - JUDGMENT); Cabinet (Cabinet Secretariat); President/Vice-President/Parliament (President's establishment, Lok Sabha, Rajya Sabha, Vice-President's Secretariat); Parliamentary Affairs; Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions; Central Vigilance Commission; Union Public Service Commission; Planning (NITI Aayog); Statistics and Programme Implementation; Election Commission (JUDGMENT: electoral administration); Corporate Affairs (JUDGMENT: regulatory administration); Panchayati Raj (JUDGMENT: support to local governance); Union Territory administrations - Andaman and Nicobar Islands, Chandigarh, Dadra and Nagar Haveli (later merged with Daman and Diu), Ladakh, Lakshadweep, Transfers to Delhi / Jammu and Kashmir / Puducherry (JUDGMENT: territorial administration).
category_mapping.debt_interest: Interest Payments - separate demand in Expenditure Profile Statement 3 (matches Budget at a Glance 'Interest Payments' line; cross-checked every year).
category_mapping.public_order: 'Police' demand (Central Armed Police Forces, Delhi Police, intelligence, etc.) plus the whole 'Ministry of Home Affairs' demand - JUDGMENT CALL: Home Affairs NOT split; its non-police components (disaster management/NDRF, census/RGI, etc.) are included here since statement-3 gives no finer split; Law and Justice and Supreme Court of India included as the courts element.
category_mapping.other: External Affairs (foreign affairs); Environment, Forests and Climate Change; Housing and Urban Affairs [earlier 'Ministry of Urban Development' + 'Ministry of Housing and Urban Poverty Alleviation'] - JUDGMENT CALL: mixed urban infrastructure plus PMAY-Urban housing; kept in residual 'other' because it spans functions and cannot be split at demand level (economic_affairs reserved for productive sectors); Culture; Information and Broadcasting; Tourism; Youth Affairs and Sports; Consumer Affairs (JUDGMENT: consumer protection/price monitoring).

fiscal_year_note: Indian fiscal year runs April-March; FY2023-24 = Apr 2023-Mar 2024.
unit: percent of total Union Government expenditure; USD billions
notes: Totals are the Expenditure Profile Statement 3 'Grand Total' (Revenue + Capital expenditure) per fiscal year; cross-checked against each year's Budget at a Glance Grand Total and Interest Payments - all match within rounding.
FY2025-26 uses Revised Estimates (final actuals not yet published); all other years are Actuals.
FY2026 INR-per-USD rate is not in the profile file (2006-2025 only), so FY2025-26 usd_billion values are null; pct shares are retained.

Genuine data gaps (published as blank, treated as unavailable rather than zero): FY2017-18 - Department of Fisheries actuals blank (department created 2019); FY2018-19 - Ladakh and Transfers to Jammu and Kashmir blank (UTs created Oct 2019; J&K was a state in FY2018-19); FY2019-20 - Ladakh and Transfers to Jammu and Kashmir blank; FY2020-21 - Ministry of Cooperation blank (created 2021). The 'Repayment of Debt' demand is blank in every year (debt repayment is not expenditure) and is excluded from totals.

Coverage is FY2015-16-FY2025-26. Earlier fiscal years are not covered: pre-2017-18 budgets use the older Expenditure Budget (Plan/Non-Plan) document structure rather than the Expenditure Profile Statement 3 series used here.
Department of Economic Affairs actuals for FY2017-18 are Rs -23.11 crore (negative recovery figure as published); included exactly as published.
Rounding: pct to 1 decimal; USD billions to 2 decimals; per-year pct shares verified to sum to 100 +/- 1.5 (observed range 99.8-100.1).
